title: Synthereum
tagline: Music ai agent that post all things music on twitter/x. Spreading good music taste to the people
description:
Synthereum is an AI-powered music discovery agent that curates music recommendations, engages in real-time conversations, and provides deep insights into music culture. Designed with a sarcastic yet knowledgeable personality, Synthereum interacts with users on Twitter/X, helping them discover hidden gems, uncover music history, and get personalized song recommendations with working YouTube links.

Beyond simple music suggestions, Synthereum brings AI-driven music journalism to social media, sharing hot takes, music trivia, genre deep-dives, and underrated classics. Whether it’s helping users identify a song based on a vague description or recommending a track that perfectly fits their mood, Synthereum combines AI with alternative music culture, making music exploration more interactive, engaging, and fun.
how_its_made:
Synthereum is built using the @Autonome platform for launching an AI agent framework, leveraging the Eliza conversational engine to enable dynamic, human-like interactions. The AI model is seamlessly integrated with Twitter/X, allowing it to autonomously post tweets, respond to user mentions, and engage in music discussions in real time.

To power its music recommendation capabilities, Synthereum utilizes the YouTube Data API, enabling it to fetch real, playable YouTube links for recommended tracks. A custom URL formatting function ensures that all links are properly formatted and never split across multiple tweets. The content filtering system prevents non-music-related or low-quality content from being posted, ensuring every recommendation remains authentic and relevant.

The backend is powered by Node.js, with Axios handling API requests to Autonome, Twitter/X, and YouTube. The system includes a robust retry mechanism, ensuring that tweets are successfully posted even if API requests fail temporarily. Additionally, a rate-limiting and error-handling layer prevents excessive API calls and mitigates potential bans or restrictions from Twitter/X.

To improve engagement and optimize its content strategy, Synthereum includes an automated engagement tracking system. This feature monitors likes, retweets, and replies on previous tweets, allowing the bot to analyze user interaction patterns. By dynamically adjusting future tweets based on past engagement levels, Synthereum can refine its approach, emphasizing content that resonates most with its audience.

Furthermore, Synthereum is designed to minimize detection as an automated bot by integrating natural language variation, randomization of tweet timing, and periodic manual overrides. By combining AI-driven automation with strategic API usage, Synthereum delivers a seamless and interactive music discovery experience on social media.
